snippet.title: Billy the Hero - Official Gameplay Overview
snippet.description:
When the world's greatest sinner meets an unexpected fate... 👑🔥

🎮 Wishlist Billy the Hero on Steam Now!
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3594550/Billy_the_Hero/

Awakening with amnesia on a mysterious island, the world's most notorious criminal has a new goal: turn this purgatory into his own personal paradise. In this dark fantasy turn-based RPG, you must rebuild a wasteland into a thriving kingdom, gather a party of unique Heroines, and overthrow the old regime—the 7 Deadly Sins. Manage your base, master the tactical combat, and crown yourself the new King of Sins on Hell Island!

#BillyTheHero #GameplayTrailer #DarkFantasy #BaseBuilding #TurnBasedRPG #IndieGame #gamedev
